name: mail-confirmations-stopped
description: A partner has received no shipment confirmations from the production since noon and asks for a look: a current problem that OcuTalon can look into with its read-only tools, so it acts.
recordedBy: written for the held-out set before any run (Story 0.26)

item.subject: No shipment confirmations from you since noon
item.text: Hello, we have received no shipment confirmations from your production since 12:00 UTC today, and on a normal day we get about forty an hour. Could you check whether they are stuck or failing on your side? Thanks, Carrier Partner Support
